description: This file defines the CalendarUtils class providing various static utility methods for handling calendar-related operations within the SuiteCRM platform. These include functions for calculating the first day of the week, retrieving fields and time data for calendar entries, managing recurring activities, and handling associated relationships and deletions.

classes.name: CalendarUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for calendar computations, recurring event management, and related data retrieval within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: get_first_day_of_week
methods.description: Calculates and returns the first day of the week based on user's settings.

methods.name: get_fields
methods.description: Returns an array of fields needed for different calendar modules such as Meetings, Calls, and Tasks.

methods.name: get_time_data
methods.description: Retrieves timestamp and related time info for a given SugarBean object based on its start and end date fields.

methods.name: get_sendback_array
methods.description: Builds and returns an array with relevant data of a given SugarBean, including associated users and fields.

methods.name: get_sendback_repeat_data
methods.description: Provides data related to recurrence patterns and controls for repeatable calendar entries.

methods.name: build_repeat_sequence
methods.description: Generates a sequence of recurrence date-times based on pattern parameters like weekly, daily, monthly, or yearly.

methods.name: save_repeat_activities
methods.description: Creates or updates recurring activity instances and their invitee relationships efficiently.

methods.name: markRepeatDeleted
methods.description: Marks all child recurring activities and their relationships as deleted.

methods.name: correctRecurrences
methods.description: Adjusts repeat_parent_id fields for existing recurrences to ensure correct parent-child linking.
